The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Terminid|text}} exclusive structure found primarily in [[Bug Nest|Bug Nests]]. These holes will continuously deploy new [[Terminids|Terminid]] units until they are destroyed. They are usually indicated by yellow-orangish spores in-game.

== Locations ==
{{Incomplete section|the number of holes usually present in each location}}
* [[Bug Nest]] (1-14)
* [[Stalker Lair]] (1-2)
* [[Shrieker Nest]] (2-3)
* [[Spore Spewer]]s (2-3, [[Mega Cities]] only)
* Terminid Hatcheries during the [[Purge Hatcheries]] mission. (6+)
* Nursery Chambers in [[Nuke Nursery]] mission (2-3)
* Certain [[Extraction Zone]] layout

== Tactical Information ==
* Bug holes can only be destroyed in two ways:
** Damaging the inside of the bug hole:
*** With a minimum demolition force of '''20''', which requires an explosive damage type.
** Damaging the outside of the bug hole:
*** With a demolition force of '''40''' or greater (which does NOT have to be explosive).
* There are various weapons and stratagems that can be used by Helldivers to destroy Bug Holes:
** Throwing an explosive type grenade inside the bug hole will destroy it. [[G-3 Smoke|Smoke Grenades]], [[G-23 Stun|Stun Grenades]], and [[K-2 Throwing Knife|Throwing Knives]] in particular '''do not''' have a high enough demolition force to close bug holes.
** Shooting a grenade inside the bug hole with the [[GL-21 Grenade Launcher]] or [[GP-31 Grenade Pistol]] will destroy it. The [[GL-52 De-Escalator]] in particular does not do not have a high enough demolition force to close bug holes.
** Shooting explosive weaponry into the bug hole will destroy it. The [[R-36 Eruptor]], [[AC-8 Autocannon]], [[CB-9 Exploding Crossbow]], and [[GR-8 Recoilless Rifle]] are among several weapons that can close bug holes.
** Certain [[Stratagems]] or weapons with a demo force of 40 or greater to destroy the hole from the outside such as [[Eagle Airstrike|Eagle Airstrikes]], [[Eagle Napalm Airstrike|Eagle Napalm Airstrikes]], [[Eagle Smoke Strike|Eagle Smoke Strikes]], [[Eagle 500kg Bomb|Eagle 500kg Bombs]], [[Orbital Laser]], [[Orbital Gas Strike]], [[Orbital Precision Strike]], [[Orbital 120mm HE Barrage|120mm]], [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage|380mm]],  and [[Orbital Walking Barrage|Walking Barrages]], [[FAF-14 Spear]], [[B-100 Portable Hellbomb]] or the [[GP-20 Ultimatum]].
** Hellpod [[Stratagems]] like the [[Resupply]], or any Support Weapon Hellpod can be used to close the hole, given the Hellpod lands on the bug hole. Helldivers are advised that they may not have access to what the Hellpod would've supplied if they do this.
** Helldivers are advised that deploying Eagle/Orbital/Defensive Stratagems while other Helldivers are present may result in accidents.

=== Medium Bug Hole ===
* Medium Bug Holes will typically spawn [[Brood Commander]]s, [[Caustic Spewer]]s and [[Nursing Spewer]]s. Starting on {{Difficulty|8}}, [[Brood Commander]]s are replaced by its variant, the [[Alpha Commander]].
** If the Medium Bug is part of a [[Stalker Lair]], it will spawn [[Stalker]]s.

=== Bile Titan Bug Hole ===
* Bile Titan Bug Hole will typically spawn [[Bile Titan]]s.
** If the [[Dragonroach]] is active on the planet, Bile Titan Bug Hole will spawn [[Charger]]s.

== Artificial Bug Hole ==
The Artificial Bug Hole variant can only be found in the [[Earn Your Helldiver Cape|tutorial]]. It is impossible to jump into one. It will close once it detects a grenade explosion inside itself.

== Bile Titan Bug Hole ==
The [[Bile Titan]] Bug Hole can be found on {{Difficulty|6}} [[missions]] and above, in specific heavy Nests and mega Nests. Instead of spawning small Terminids, it will spawn Bile Titans. It is much bigger than standard Bug Holes and requires at least [[Demolition]] Force '''40''' to destroy.

* Worth noting is that [[Hellpod|Hellpods]] have a demolition force of 40. Therefore, calling down a Hellpod Stratagem onto the Bile Titan Hole will close it, though as mentioned earlier on this page, the called-down stratagem itself might become inaccessible.
* It is also possible to have a Bile Titan carcass crash down onto the hole and close it. This can be achieved by taking down a guarding bile titan without alerting it first, or eliminating one as it emerges from the bug hole.

== Medium Bug Hole ==
The Medium Bug Hole can be found on {{Difficulty|4}} or above as part of [[Stalker Lair|Stalker Lairs]], in Heavy Nests, or [[Bug Nest|Mega Nests]]

The Medium Bug Hole shares the same stats as a small Bug Hole.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}'''  is a [[Terminids|Terminid]] structure and [[Missions#Optional Objectives|Optional Objective]]. To complete the objective, [[Helldiver]]s must destroy the structure. 

== Spore Spewers ==
Spore Spewers (also known as a '''Fog Generator'''<ref>Patch 01.000.300, Regular Update, Steam, 2024-04-29, https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/553850/view/4169846298204053636</ref>), are large [[Terminids|Terminid]] structures which continuously produce a thick cloud of spores in a large radius around itself.  While said spores do not damage the [[Helldivers]], the spores significantly reduce visibility in a large radius, hiding enemy units.

[[Samples]] can always be found around the Spore Spewer, and occasionally have a few [[Bug Hole]] structures.  Destroying these holes is not required to complete the objective. They are also labeled as "Enemy Unit" when tagged.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Terminid]] Structure and Optional Objective for Terminid [[Missions]], in which the goal is to destroy a '''Stalker Lair.''' 
== Stalker Nests ==
[[File:Termind_City_Stalker_Lair.png|thumb|left|x200px|alt=| A Stalker Nest structure within the limits of a [[Colonies|Colony]]]]
Stalker Nests are a unique variant of [[Terminids|Terminid]] [[Bug Hole]].  While Helldivers are nearby, the Stalker Nests will regularly spawn the unique [[Stalker|Stalker]] enemy, a large, durable, heavy hitting Terminid with the ability to cloak.

As Stalkers are some of the deadlier Terminid enemies, closing the nests is a top priority.  However, the Stalker Lair Bug Holes can be destroyed in the same manner as ordinary Bug Holes, via explosives with a [[Demolition]] force of 20 (if a grenade is tossed inside) or any weapon with a demolition force of 40 or higher such as the [[GP-20 Ultimatum]].

{{Clear}}

== Objective Steps ==
* Destroy Stalker Lair
** There are 1-2 unique [[Bug Hole]] structures around the Stalker Nest.  They can be destroyed in the same manner as any other bug hole. 
* Reward: {{Currency|Requisition Slips|200}} & {{Currency|Experience|50}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Stalker holes can only be destroyed in two ways:
** Damaging the inside of the bug hole:
*** With a minimum demolition force of '''20''', which requires an '''explosive''' damage type.
** Damaging the outside of the bug hole:
*** With a demolition force of '''40''' or greater.
**** A single well placed [[TED-63 Dynamite]] grenade can destroy 2 holes.
* Helldivers should immediately destroy these Lairs, as Stalkers are one of the most dangerous [[Enemies|enemy]] types.
* Stalkers Lairs ''can'' also spawn small Terminids such as [[Scavenger|Scavengers]].
* Helldivers can easily locate Stalker Lairs by searching in the direction Stalkers are coming from, and looking for the orange glow of the bug holes.

'''Detector Tower''' is an [[Missions#Tactical Objectives|Optional Objective]] exclusive to the {{Automaton|text}}, consisting of a large, rotating surveillance tower that will summon reinforcements if it detects the presence of Helldivers. To complete the objective, Helldivers must destroy the tower.

== Objective Steps ==
* Destroy Automaton Detector Tower
** The [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]] will be available to call down when near the tower.
* Rewards: {{Currency|Requisition|200}}, {{Currency|Experience|50}}

== Tactical Information<!-- Old version mentioned "active Hellpod-stratagems" as being valid Detector Tower targets as well, confused if this means sentries/emplacements -->==

* The Detector Tower has a 150-meter range in which it can detect Helldivers, within its distinctive red vision cone.
** The position of the vision cone means that Helldivers that are very close to the Detector Tower cannot be spotted.
** Going prone will render Helldivers completely invisible to the Detector Tower.
* If a Helldiver is spotted, the tower will sound an audible alarm and begin summoning constant waves of bot drops until it can no longer see any Helldivers.
** [[Dropship|Dropships]] spawned in this manner will deploy their units on the last known position of the Helldiver.
* The [[Demolition]] requirement of 50 means that a Hellbomb is unnecessary if alternate options are available.
** Common examples include the [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]], [[Orbital Precision Strike]] and [[SEAF Artillery]] shells.
** Clever positioning can trick [[Cannon Turret|Cannon Turrets]] into destroying the Detector Tower with their shots.
* The Hellbomb's large AOE means that it can be called down far away from the Detector Tower (where one is at little risk of being spotted) and still complete the objective.
* Detector Towers will occasionally spawn inside of [[Automaton Outpost|Fortresses]]. They function identically to standard Detector Towers, but the Hellbomb will '''not''' be available to call down to destroy them. They are also not mandatory to destroy to mark the Fortress as "cleared".

== Trivia ==

* Due to the Tower's distinctive appearance, it is often colloquially referred to as the [[wikipedia:en:Lord of the Rings|'Eye of Sauron']] by many Helldivers.
* Detector Towers can be used to farm Automaton kills for [[Major Orders]], as their alarm state bypasses the global cooldown of bot flares, allowing a constant stream of incoming [[Dropship|Dropships]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an Optional Objective contained within an [[Automatons|Automaton]] structure. For as long as it is standing, it disables the ability for Helldivers within 150m to call down any [[Stratagems|Stratagem]] '''except''' for [[SEAF Artillery]]. To complete the Objective, Helldivers must destroy the structure.

== Objective Steps ==
* Destroy Automaton Stratagem Jammer.
** If SEAF Artillery is available, Mini-Nuke & High-Yield Explosive can hit nearby, while Explosive, Napalm, Static Field & Smoke shells must hit the jammer directly to destroy it. This can be done while the jammer is either active or disabled.
** Helldivers must interact with the terminal at the base of the Jammer to disable it, then call in a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb|Hellbomb]] or a Stratagem with minimum [[Demolition|demolition force]] of '''50''' of their choosing to destroy it.
* Reward: {{Currency| Requisition Slips|200}} & {{Currency|Experience|50}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The building that needs to be demolished requires a demolition force of '''50''', which means it can be destroyed by other means than a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]].
* A recommended tactic is to fire the [[MS-11 Solo Silo]] at the jammer to wipe out any static enemies within the outpost to facilitate the raid into the structure.
* Should the entire squad perish within the range of Stratagem Jammer, the [[Reinforce]] stratagem will be automatically deployed by the edge of the jamming radius, towards the center of the mission area.
* A smart tactic some Helldivers use is to bait a [[Cannon Turret|Cannon Turrets]], [[Annihilator Tank|Annihilator Tanks]], [[Factory Strider|Factory Striders]], or [[Vox Engine|Vox Engines]] into shooting them with the structure behind them, but taking cover immediately so they will shoot and destroy the structure as their powerful lasers have a demolition force of 50.
** The [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]], [[Orbital Precision Strike]], [[Orbital 120mm HE Barrage]], [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage]], or [[Orbital Walking Barrage]] can be used destroy the jammer when it is deactivated.
*** Additionally The [[Orbital Gas Strike]], [[Orbital EMS Strike]], [[Orbital Smoke Strike]] and [[Orbital Railcannon Strike]] all have the capacity to destroy the jammer, requiring a direct hit.
** SEAF Artillery: Mini-Nuke, High-Yield Explosive, Explosive, Napalm, Smoke and Static Field as well as the [[B-100 Portable Hellbomb]] can destroy the jammer '''without''' disabling it.
*** Napalm, Smoke & Static Field require a direct hit.
* If any stratagem balls are thrown into the range of the jammer, they will neither activate nor enter into a cooldown period.
* Throwing the Stratagem ball of the [[Orbital Walking Barrage]] just outside of the Jammer's radius will still allow the barrages shells to land inside the jammers range. If the barrage is faced directly towards the jammer, it is even possible to destroy it (albeit slowly) with the last few shells.
* It is possible for multiple jammers to spawn within the 150m jamming range of each other. This means that to destroy them, you must interact with the terminals of both of them to disable both jammers before Helldivers can call in a NUX-223 Hellbomb to destroy them, use a [[B-100 Portable Hellbomb]] to destroy one so the other can be destroyed by either mission hellbomb or other demo 50 stratagems or use SEAF Artillery.

== Trivia ==
* The stratagem disabling effect applied while under its area of influence is called "Electronic Countermeasures", a name shared with a [[Electronic Countermeasures|retired Operation Modifier]].

The {{Terminids}} '''Terminids''' are one of three current factions the [[The Helldivers|Helldivers]] can fight against, with the others being the {{Automatons}} [[Automatons]] and the {{Illuminate}} [[Illuminate]]. They have four sub-factions: The {{Predator Strain|text}}, the {{Spore Burst Strain|text}}, the {{Rupture Strain|text}}, the [[Caustic Strain]], and the [[Noxious Strain]] == Overview == {{Quote|The ravenous Terminids are guided solely by an instinctive urge to reproduce, spread, and destroy Democracy. They are a fast-evolving plague, a shapeshifting infestation that threatens to devour and disenfranchise every single child on every single planet.|Playstation Store Description|image=Terminid icon.svg|imagesize=80px}} The Terminids, insect-like creatures referred to as ''Bugs'' before their scientific name was given, are rapidly-reproducing, swarming aliens. Much of the Terminids attack using their claws and acidic bile. They now swarm the planets north-east of the [[Sol System]]. == Acid == Acid, also known as Bile, is the preferred method of dealing damage for some Terminids, namely, the [[Caustic Spitter]], [[Nursing Spewer]], [[Caustic Spewer]] and [[Bile Titan]]. The [[Bug Mine]] also applies acid to creatures that step on it. The {{Automatons}} '''Automatons''' are one of three factions the [[The Helldivers|Helldivers]] can fight against, with the others being the {{Terminids|text= Terminids}} and the {{Illuminate|text= Illuminate}}. They also have three subfactions: the {{Jet Brigade|text=Jet Brigade}}, {{Incineration Corps|text= Incineration Corps}}, and {{Cyborg Legion|text= Cyborg Legion}}. == Overview == [[File:Automaton Logo.png|thumb|right|200px|The flag of The Collective]] {{Quote|The Automatons are mindless, bloodthirsty robots, coded for nothing but murder and socialist violence. Their origins are a mystery, but their unthinking hatred of Freedom makes them a threat to all citizens of [[Federation of Super Earth|Super Earth]].| Playstation Store Description|image=Automaton icon.svg|imagesize=80px}} The '''Automatons''' - colloquially known as ''Bots'' - are intelligent robotic beings created by the {{Cyborgs}} [[Helldivers 1:Cyborgs|Cyborgs]] before the events of the [[Second Galactic War]]. {{cite twitter | url = https://twitter.com/HelldiversGame/status/1453120725917831169 | tweet = Description: a series of tweets containing an encrypted binary message | access_date = May 24th, 2025 }} {{cite web | url = https://www.reddit.com/r/Helldivers/comments/qgqosr/comment/hi7x3of/ | quote = We, the collective from Cyberstan, unanimously assert our independence from Super Earth. We have the right to defend our home from the brainwashed Helldivers. Our children, the automaton will not suffer as we have under the oppression of Super Earth! | title = Decrypted message | date = October 27th, 2021 | website =r/Helldivers on Reddit, }} Conversation between Community Manager Baskinator and Discord user Charon regarding chronology and canonicity of the Cyborg Twitter message File:Cyborg Message.png|Conversation between Baskinator and Charon File:Cyborg Message 2.png|Conversation continued They are fully capable of feeling emotions - such as sorrow and anger''"Intercepted bot chatter includes expressions of great sorrow for the "murder" of in-development bots—a transparent attempt at disinformation, as bots can neither feel nor be considered alive. However, the simulated oaths of vengeance may indicate actual strategic intent. A counteroffensive is likely."'' - {{MajorOrderLink|id=A1-3-7|text=Major Order A1-3-7 outcome briefing}} - and having independent thoughts. They predominantly utilize fusion weapons, rockets, and melee weapons. The '''Automatons''' first appeared in the south-western [[Sector]]s of the Galactic Map with a vanguard force. Their main force would only arrive later during [[The Reclamation]], settling in the [[Valdis Sector]] and re-uniting with their creators on [[Cyberstan]]. In terms of gameplay, the '''Automatons''' utilize various types of ranged weaponry and heavily-armored units to overwhelm the Helldivers. == Lore == === Origin === {{Quote|Vessel 00 is indicated to be a spaceship that departed from the planet Cyberstan in 2180, approximately 4 years prior to the initial Automaton attack. The cargo and destination of that voyage is unknown, but it is referred to as the final one the ship made. Vessel 00 is referred to in exultation - evidence of Automaton programming to express reverence towards it. It is additionally referred to as their seed or origin. This intel raises many troubling questions. The origin of the Automatons has been a top intel priority since their initial barbaric assault. This information is the first to definitively connect the Automatons to Cyberstan, a rehabilitation planet invaded by them in the early days of the war.|{{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-10-1|text=Major Order A2-10-1 outcome briefing}}}} According to intel gathered from [[Database One]], the Automatons originated from Cyberstan. {{Tabs | name1 = Helldivers 2 | link1 = Illuminate | name2 = Helldivers 1 | link2 = Helldivers 1:The Illuminate }} {{Breadcrumb Auto | title = Illuminate | description = Illuminate Faction Page | overview = Factions | parent = Factions }}

The {{Illuminate}} '''Illuminate''' are one of three factions the [[The Helldivers|Helldivers]] can fight against, with the others being the {{Terminids|text=Terminids}} and the {{Automatons|text=Automatons}}. They have four subfactions: the {{Mindless Masses|text}}, {{Appropriators|text}}, {{Vote Snatchers|text}} and {{Invasion Fleet|text}}. == Overview == [[File:Omens of Tyranny Trailer Illuminate Trio.png|thumb|right|350px|The Illuminate]] {{Quote|An ancient, “highly advanced” species, desperately seeking to reclaim their former galactic supremacy. These mind-controlling, xenophobic aliens cannot be reasoned with. They must all be killed.|Playstation Store Description|image=Illuminate icon.svg|imagesize=80px}} The '''Illuminate''' - colloquially known as ''Squids'' - are an ancient hierarchical[[Democracy Officer#True Illuminate Invasion|Democracy Officer]]: ''"According to historical texts, the Illuminate society is strictly hierarchical. Their leaders may be over a thousand years old. But ancient though they may be, their return has sealed their doom."'' alien species named ''[[Helldivers 1:Encyclopedia#THE ILLUMINATE|Squ'ith]]'' who were originally aquatic in nature. Few in number, they possess exceptionally long lifespans (upwards of a thousand years) and highly advanced technology - such as stealth and shielding capabilities. Following their near-extinction[[Democracy Officer#True Illuminate Invasion|Democracy Officer]]: ''"We defeated the Illuminate in the First Galactic War, but were too lenient in our cleansing of their viscous imprint. Now we pay the price."''[[Strohmann News#Illuminate Return|Strohmann News broadcast]]: ''"The advanced and highly xenophobic beings were thought exterminated in the First Galactic War (...)"'' after the events of the [[First Galactic War]], the surviving '''Illuminate''' fled outside {{Super Earth}}[[Federation of Super Earth|Super Earth]] controlled space into an unknown portion of the galaxy[[Democracy Officer#True Illuminate Invasion|Democracy Officer]]:''"It seems that the black hole created by the Dark Fluid was in fact a wormhole, to some dark depths of the galaxy in which the Illuminate were hidden."''. They would eventually return to federation space 100 years later via the {{IconPOI|Orb}} [[Meridian Black Hole|Meridian Wormhole]]. In terms of gameplay, the '''Illuminate''' utilize vast hordes of [[Voteless]] and [[Fleshmob]]s to swarm the Helldivers while various types of [[Overseer]]s attack from a distance. Extensive gameplay data indicates that on [[Difficulty|Super Helldive]] difficulty, the secondary objectives on the Illuminate front are almost invariably A.[[SEAF Artillery]], B.[[SEAF SAM Site]], C.[[Cognitive Disruptor]], D.[[Radar Station]], E.[[Purge Illuminate]], and F.[[Destroy Rogue Research Station]]—with E and F alternating. Five secondary objectives can appear on a mission (three during city operations). == Lore == === [[First Galactic War]] === Before the [[First Galactic War]], the {{Illuminate}} '''Illuminate''' society had endured for several [[Helldivers 1:Encyclopedia#THE ILLUMINATE|hundred thousands of years]]. They first approached the {{Super Earth}} [[Federation of Super Earth]] with a peace offering[[Helldivers 1:Science Officer| Helldivers 1, Science Officer]]: ''"The Illuminates consider themselves enlightened, hence the name. They initially came to earth with a treacherous peace offering which later turned out to be false as they had large quantities of world-destroying devices nicknamed 'obliterator bombs'. Needless to say, the only sensible solution was to wipe them out with a preemptive strike."'', however the Federation '''accused''' them of possessing Weapons of Mass Destruction (WMDs) capable of destroying entire planets[[Helldivers 1:The Illuminate#Gallery|Helldivers 1, War Declared: Illuminate]]: ''" 'We have reason to believe the Illuminates have Weapons of Mass Destruction, capable of destroying entire planets' stated house representative Powley Colle. He continued 'Every statement I make today is backed up by reliable sources' "''. Using this '''supposed''' threat as justification, humankind waged war against the Illuminate and ultimately defeated them. After their defeat, the Illuminate were forced to [[Helldivers 1:The Illuminate#Gallery|surrender their technology]] before being almost completely exterminated by Super Earth. While Super Earth believed them extinct, some Illuminate survivors fled into unknown space, away from the Federation's purview. This near-total eradication would drastically alter their society during this period of isolation{{cite web | url = https://www.reddit.com/r/LowSodiumHellDivers/comments/1hdrfr0/comment/m21h3yc/ | title = Anyone else notice how Illuminate are a LOT more... brutal this time around? | author = Pilestdt | date = December 24th, 2024 | quote = "💯 And the illuminates that survived probably don't have any issues with their ancestors' soft and apathetic approach to humanity that resulted in their millenia long stewardship of the galaxy being lost." }}, as they would begin [[The Great Host|plotting their revenge]]. === Second Galactic War === 100 years later, the creation of the {{IconPOI|Orb}} [[Meridian Wormhole]] would prompt the '''Illuminate''' to return to Federation space through it. At first, they remained hidden while abducting large amounts of colonists[[Democracy Officer#Illuminate Invasion|Democracy Officer]]: ''"The mystery of our vanishing colonists is at last solved. They were abducted by the Illuminate, and transfigured into the betentacled assailants with which we must now contend."'', but later revealed themselves with a massive attack on [[Calypso]]. This invasion used small squads of elite [[Overseer]]s supported by swarms of [[Voteless]]: zombie-like creatures created from abducted and mutated Super Earth colonists. This brutal attack was just barely repelled thanks to the efforts of the [[The Helldivers|Helldivers]], but further attacks soon followed. Throughout the months after their return, the Illuminate invaded several planets in order to generate [[Dark Energy]] to {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-2-2|text=move}} the Meridian Wormhole - which destroyed [[Angel's Venture]], [[Moradesh]], and [[Ivis]] in its path towards [[Super Earth]] itself. However Federation efforts, such as a {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-3-2|text=partial blockade}} and deployment of the [[Penrose Energy Siphon]], slowed the Singularity; it was ultimately stopped with the activation of the [[Repulsive Gravity Field Generator]] shortly after the destruction of Ivis. The Illuminate briefly vanished from the Galactic Map after the Wormhole was halted, in preparation of their incoming invasion. Shortly afterwards, a massive Illuminate invasion armada - presumably built over 100 years[[Democracy Officer#True Illuminate Invasion|Democracy Officer]]: ''"The Illuminate likely spent the past hundred years constructing this fleet. Its gargantuan size is a reflection of our enemy's hatred for all things Free."'' - known as [[The Great Host]] would emerge from the Meridian Wormhole and begin its march towards Super Earth itself. The fleet first made landfall on [[Widow's Harbor]], and brought with it new units to bolster the Illuminate invasion: the [[Stingray]], [[Fleshmob]]s, and [[Crescent Overseer]]s. The Illuminate fleet reached the Solar System on May 20th, 2185. First razing [[Mars]], then moving to Super Earth. Their forces began attacks on the seven [[Mega City|Megacities]] of Super Earth, first landing on [[Mega City#Mega City 5 - Eagleopolis|Eagleopolis]]. They were eventually defeated and retreated to the southern sectors, hidden from Super Earth's detection until their cloaking methods were revealed. On [[Major Orders#A3-3-4|March 17th, 2186]], the {{Appropriators}} '''[[Appropriators]]''', a subfaction of the Illuminate that fields only Squ'ith units and piloted constructs, would be detected setting up [[Destroy Exospire|Exospires]] powered by [[Dark Fluid]] from the ruins on [[Seasse]], creating an [[Exostorm]] that sent a purple beam into the sky, stirring the weather across the planet and affecting its atmospheric integrity. Despite suffering casualties from Helldivers operation on the planet, the Illuminate succeeded in their goal, enveloping the entire system in what would be called [[The Void]]. Several hours after The Void came into existence, the {{Appropriators}} '''Appropriators''' arrived at [[Hort]], [[Major Order#A3-3-6|setting up additional Exospires with the intention of expanding The Void]] while simutaneously, the {{Mindless Masses}} '''[[Mindless Masses]]''', a subfaction of the Illuminate that had increased presence of Voteless and Fleshmobs, launched an attack on [[Rirga Bay]]. === Language === The Illuminate alphabet and their language use glyphs{{Cite Discord|url=https://discord.com/channels/1102970375731691612/1204429333972910091/1525089238859911288|author=Baskinator|channel=lore|message=They can communicate... They sure make an awful racket, so I assume that's them yapping.
Their language uses glyphs. We don't have a complete translation of their symbols available.
But I have shared with this group that :hd2squid: is their symbol for themselves.}}. However, their faction symbol {{Illuminate}} has been revealed to be a stylized glyph of the Illuminate’s word for themselves. Conversation between Community Manager Baskinator and Discord user Charon regarding Illuminate eyelids and their faction symbol. Illuminate Eyelids.png|Conversation between Baskinator and Charon Illuminate Eyelids 2.png|Conversation continued == List of Illuminate Units== === Standard Illuminate === category=Illuminate notcategory=Appropriators notcategory=Vote Snatchers uses=Template:Infobox Enemy mode=userformat ordermethod=sortkey format=,File:%PAGE% Enemy Icon.png|link=[[%PAGE%]]|[[%PAGE%]] ,\n, === Appropriators === {{main|Appropriators}} category=Appropriators notcategory=Subfactions uses=Template:Infobox Enemy mode=userformat ordermethod=sortkey format=,File:%PAGE% Enemy Icon.png|link=[[%PAGE%]]|[[%PAGE%]] ,\n, === Vote Snatchers === {{main|Vote Snatchers}} category=Vote Snatchers notcategory=Subfactions uses=Template:Infobox Enemy mode=userformat ordermethod=sortkey format=,File:%PAGE% Enemy Icon.png|link=[[%PAGE%]]|[[%PAGE%]] ,\n, ===Invasion Fleet=== {{main|Invasion Fleet}} == List of Illuminate Structures == Cognitive Disruptor.png|[[Cognitive Disruptor]] Destroy Exospire Dark Fluid Cells.png|[[Destroy Exospire#Disrupt Exospire Core|Dark Fluid Cell]] File:Gazer_Enemy_Icon_Render.png|[[Gazer]] Illuminate Gazer Spire.png|[[Gazer Spire]] Warp Ship Bay Door.png|[[Grounded Warp Ship]] Illuminate Icon.svg|[[Illuminate Encampment]] Illuminate Lightning Spire.png|[[Lightning Spire]] Monolith POI.png|[[Monolith]] Destroy Exospire Core Entrance Shield Generator Site.png|[[Destroy Exospire#Disrupt Shield Generator(s)|Shield Generator]] Illuminate Warp Gateway.png|[[Warp Gateway]] == Tactical Information == * Most Illuminates have a low armor rating in exchange for being fairly tanky. Helldivers should primarily invest in high-DPS equipment over high-penetration equipment. * The Illuminate reward fast and agile gameplay for a number of reasons: ** Compared to small Terminids, [[Voteless]] move slower, have a shorter lunge range, and are incapable of leaping at enemies. Light Helldivers can often simply run past them without much hassle. ** Ranged Illuminates typically either have low velocity projectiles or low "ergonomics", frequently allowing Helldivers to sidestep or outright outrun them. * Many Illuminates are equipped with [[Harvester#Anatomy|shields]] or [[Overseer#Anatomy|armor plating]] that nullify or reduce overkill damage, punishing single, powerful shots while rewarding continuous, incremental damage. * Illuminates can only be reinforced by [[Watcher|Watchers]]; small, agile, flying enemies that are relatively hard to kill for their size. They hover above the battlefield, weaving between structures and emerging when least expected. Because of this, target prioritization is ''key'' when fighting on the Illuminate front; Helldivers cannot simply rely on them being hit by a stray bullet in the heat of battle like enemies that can call for reinforcements on the other fronts. * Other than some [[Destroy Exospire|exceptions]], non-[[Metropolis|city]] Illuminate missions always have [[Colonies|Colony]] megastructures. Helldivers should generally be prepared for close quarters combat. ** Despite this general rule, the exact percentage of the mission area that is occupied by a colony, as well as the number of objectives in the colony, can differ drastically from mission to mission. Helldivers should always make sure to inspect the map before making a final decision on their loadout. * Illuminates frequently use [[Damage#Damage Types|Explosion]] damage and commonly use [[Arc]] damage. Helldivers should plan accordingly. * Some Illuminates have asymmetrical anatomy, which can mildly alter how Helldivers combat them. In particular: ** Destroying an [[Overseer|Overseer's]] (all variants) right arm is fatal for them, while destroying their left isn't. ** Certain sections of armor on [[Harvester|Harvesters']] left legs have slightly less health or drastically less durability. To compensate for this, their left hip joint transfers less damage to main. * [[Illuminate Encampment|Illuminate Encampments]] are large, owing in part to the size of [[Grounded Warp Ship|Grounded Warp Ships]]. This has a few implications: ** Illuminate Encampments spawn in far fewer number than Outposts for the other factions, often as little as 2 on certain difficulties. ** Due to the size of Grounded Warp Ships, they are fairly easy to take out with Orbital Barrages. == Trivia == * They were made available to fight immediately after their reveal at The Game Awards 2024 on December 13th, 2024. * Super Earth frequently calls the Illuminate society "Autocratic" despite no evidence of this claim being present anywhere in the game. * UFO sightings during the 21st century were actually Illuminate recon ships[[Helldivers 1: Science Officer]]: ''"The Illuminate have had settlements in this galaxy for millennia. In the late 21st century there were plenty of Illuminate recon ship sightings, but these were dismissed as folklore back then."''. * It is unknown how the surviving Illuminate were treated after their defeat. Some sources state that a genocide took place and they were believed exterminated, while others state that they were displaced outside the galaxy. * Some of the Illuminate technology is seemingly biotechnological in nature. This can be observed on the [[Leviathan]]'s internals being fleshy, as well as various autonomous units ''bleeding'' as they die: Watcher Death Bleed 2.png|''A Watcher bleeding as it dies'' Harvester Death Bleed.png|''A Harvester bleeding as it dies'' Stingray Death Bleed.png|''A Stingray bleeding as it dies'' Leviathan Death Bleed.png|''A Leviathan bleeding as it dies'' * Squ'ith do not possess eyelids in the terrestrial sense, and they cannot blink like humans. == Posters == Avenge Mars Poster.png|''Avenge Mars'' on May 20th, 2025. ** The [[PLAS-45 Epoch]] is a 1 shot with an uncharged shot.

** Weapons that only have {{Armor|4|AV}} penetration should still try to target the heatsinks because of the damage reduction incurred against equal armor. This is especially true for weapons that also inflict shrapnel damage, as shrapnel is only {{Armor|3|AP}} penetrating.

== Tactical Information ==
* One second after hitting the ground, the Caltrops will explode into a small field of several proximity-triggered stun mines, dealing low damage and stunning nearby enemies that detonate a mine.
* Caltrops can be used similarly to other mines, in order to cover an area that a Helldiver cannot.
** Due to their low damage, it is better to use Caltrops as a "proximity alarm" in this sense, alerting Helldivers that enemies have breached the area.
** Alternatively, Caltrops are effective in tight choke-points or when placed in front of patrol paths, as Helldivers can take advantage of the slowing effect by exploiting an enemy's weak spots or using offensive [[Stratagems]] (such as an [[Eagle Strafing Run]]).
* In an emergency, Caltrops can be used as an improvised [[G-23 Stun]] grenade, as it will stun enemies, giving Helldivers a chance to reposition.
** Careful consideration must be taken to ensure Helldivers do not stun themselves when attempting close-range use of Caltrops, as this will almost certainly mean death when surrounded by enemies.
* Caltrops have a significantly shorter throwing range than other throwables, only being able to be thrown a few meters away. It is highly recommended to aim upwards when throwing to ensure Helldivers don't get stunned when it lands and arms.
** Alternatively, Helldivers may utilize armors with the {{Passive|Desert Stormer}} or {{Passive|Servo-Assisted}} passives to increase the throwing range.
* Like other [[Mines (disambiguation)|mines]], Caltrops can be detonated early by shooting them.
* Caltrops have two weapon modes: narrow spread and wide spread

* The Seeker grenade is impact-fused like the [[G-16 Impact]] and [[G-13 Incendiary Impact]] grenades and will instantly detonate once it hits a target, ground, wall, etc. 
** Damage from outside sources (explosions, being shot mid-flight by a Helldiver or enemy) will not detonate the Seeker grenade.
* Seeker grenades have a detection/seeking radius seems to be about 50 meters.
** Seeker grenades seem to ignore their range limit when targeting [[Gunship|Gunships]].
* It takes 2 Seeker grenades to the heatsink of a [[Tank]] or [[Cannon Turret]] to destroy it.
* If a Seeker grenade detects no targets after being thrown, it will hover around the user until a target comes within range, or until its 30s lifetime is depleted. If the battery runs out, the G-50 will harmlessly fall to the ground rather than explode.

** [[Bulk Fabricator|Bulk Fabricators]] can be destroyed very rarely: the ping is placed near ground level, while the vulnerable vents are on top.
** A marked (pinged) [[Grounded Warp Ship]] can be destroyed when the grenade is thrown from the door side.

** Seeker grenades themselves can be pinged, although there isn't really any use in doing so.
* Seeker grenades will prioritize attacking - and are notably effective against - aerial targets, typically only taking 1 - 2 to destroy [[Gunship|Gunships]], or strafing [[Stingray|Stingrays]].

{{Quote|Equipped with a heavy payload suitable against armored vehicles, this grenade delivery drone follows the user until it detects an enemy nearby, then flies towards it and explodes on impact.|Armory Description}}

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (also known as the '''AT Seeker''') is a [[Weapons#Special-2|Special Throwable]] in ''[[Helldivers 2]]''. Similar to the [[G-50 Seeker]], it is an anti-tank grenade that can fly and will explode on impact.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the third page of the [[Ironclad Democracy Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|65}}.

== Detailed Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|G-60 Anti-Tank Seeker}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The G-60 Anti-Tank Seeker grenade is an impact-fused grenade and will instantly detonate once it hits a solid object (target, ground, wall, etc.).
** Damage from outside sources (explosions, being shot mid-flight by a Helldiver or enemy) will not detonate it.
* G-60 Anti-Tank Seeker grenades have a detection/seeking radius of around 50 meters.
** When visibility is obstructed by weather conditions such as blizzards or sandstorms, the target detection range is reduced to 30 meters.
* It takes one Anti-Tank Seeker to destroy a [[Hulk]] in the torso.
* Seeker grenades will prioritize homing in on enemy targets that are marked (pinged) by the Helldiver that threw them, given that the marked targets are within the Seeker grenade's range.
* Seeker grenades interact with spawners as follows:
** [[Automaton Fabricator|Fabricators]] can usually be destroyed with one grenade. When marked (pinged), the grenade can pass through their walls and detonate inside near the vulnerable vent.
** [[Bulk Fabricator|Bulk Fabricators]] can be destroyed very rarely: the ping is placed near ground level, while the vulnerable vents are on top.
** A marked (pinged) [[Grounded Warp Ship]] can be destroyed when the grenade is thrown from the door side.
** [[Bug Hole|Bug Holes]] cannot be destroyed because Seeker grenades do not target them.
* Unlike other AT throwables, they are rather unreliable against [[Bile Titan]]s when targeting the main body. In theory, they have the damage output to kill them, however their flight pattern may not hit a fatal area, and more likely to hit its armored shell, or legs.
** In order to maximize their effectiveness, Helldivers should have a clear line-of-sight on a Bile Titan's main head/body before throwing it.
** Alternatively, Helldivers can throw multiple grenades to increase their chances of killing the Bile Titan, trading effectiveness for ease of use.

{{Quote|A smoke grenade that rapidly deploys a small, dense cloud. Allows for rapid personal concealment and exfiltration.|Armory Description}}

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Weapons#Special-2|Special Throwable]] that is used to create a temporary smoke screen to obscure [[Helldiver|Helldivers]] upon impact.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} can be bought from the [[Redacted Regiment Premium Warbond|Redacted Regiment]] page on the [[Superstore]] for {{Currency|SC|300}}.

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data Weapon}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Rather than dealing [[Damage Types|damage]], this grenade creates three small smoke clouds that last for 30 seconds each. The clouds often coalesce to form one block of smoke, capable of obscuring the vision of both [[Helldiver|Helldivers]] and any [[Factions|Enemies]].
** As it lacks damage (and by extension, demolition force), the G-89 Smokescreen cannot destroy [[Bug Hole|Bug Holes]], [[Automaton Fabricator|Automaton Fabricators]], or [[Grounded Warp Ship|Grounded Warp Ships]].
* Compared to the [[G-3 Smoke]], the G-89 Smokescreen has no fuse time and instead creates a smoke cloud on impact. This feature prevents cases where it could bounce unpredictably and create a cloud of smoke in an undesired place, and allows for more immediate deployment.
** In exchange, the G-89 Smokescreen has a noticeably smaller radius of created smoke comparing to its counterpart. 
* Enemies that have lost sight with Helldivers entering smoke will still approach where they were last seen. Helldivers should continue retreating away from the smoke to better lose enemies' attention.
** Enemies can still detect Helldivers within the smoke if they are close enough. Helldivers should first disengage or eliminate nearby enemies before obscuring themselves with smoke.
* The {{Automaton}}[[Automatons]] are most affected by the G-89 Smokescreen due to their tendency to fight at range, making it easier to disengage.
* The {{Terminids}}[[Terminids]] are less affected by the G-89 Smokescreen, as they continuously move through the smoke towards their target's last known location. If far away enough from a chasing horde, Helldivers can utilize nearby terrain with smoke to break line of sight for a longer period of time.
* Similar to the Terminids, the {{Illuminate}}[[Illuminate]] are less affected by the G-89 Smokescreen as well, due to the rushing nature of the [[Voteless]] and [[Fleshmob|Fleshmobs]].
** The G-89 Smokescreen can be more effectively utilized to hamper attacks at range from [[Harvester|Harvesters]], [[Overseer|Overseers]], [[Elevated Overseer|Elevated Overseers]], and [[Crescent Overseer|Crescent Overseers]].
* The G-89 Smokescreen can also be used to carefully complete high-risk [[Missions|mission]] objectives, such as the [[Prospecting Drill|Prospecting Drills]] for the [[Conduct Geological Survey]]. The obscured [[Helldiver]] operating the drill can avoid being targeted by enemies pushing on the objective.

== Procurement ==

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data_Weapon|G/SH-39 Shield}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The {{PAGENAME}} protects units inside the shield from point blank [[Ultimatum]], [[Solo Silo]], [[Leveller]], and [[Orbital Precision Strike]] explosions (as well as the explosions from [[Walking Barrage]], [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage]] and [[Orbital 120mm HE Barrage]] shells), but not impacts, as those will destroy the shield with the impact damage before the explosion triggers. 
** A direct hit is survivable by stacking shields. Helldivers will not be ragdolled when protected from these hits.
** Combining the G/SH-39 Shield with a Leveller shot point-blank at a [[Vox Engine]]'s underside vent is the most consistent method to dispatch them in one shot.
*The {{PAGENAME}} can be used to provide impromptu cover for [[Emplacement Stratagems|emplacements]] and [[Sentry Stratagems|sentries]].
**It can also be used to protect a [[Hellbomb]] from being destroyed or prematurely detonated by enemy fire.
* The {{PAGENAME}} will not protect units inside the shield from [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]] and [[Hellbomb]] explosions within the inner radius of those explosions (10 and 17 meters respectively). 
** Helldivers outside the inner radius of these explosions can still be ragdolled and sent flying by the explosion through the shield. 
** Stacking shields provides no protective benefits against these explosions.
* The {{PAGENAME}} can be used to survive many situations that would otherwise be fatal, such as landing in front of a fully armed and operational [[Factory Strider]], being strafed by a [[Stingray]], or being surrounded by multiple [[Stalker]]s. 
** Since the Shield must be thrown first, it is recommended to use it proactively, not reactively.
** Terminids can walk through the Shield, but due to its small size, if a Helldiver stands in the middle of the shield, Terminids will not attempt to walk through the shield and instead attack the Helldiver fruitlessly.
*The G/SH-39 Shield can be used to defend a Helldiver while interacting with terminals. This is notably useful while arming Hellbombs as the shield is large enough to protect both the Hellbomb and the Helldiver from enemy fire.
* Similar to the [[FX-12 Shield Generator Relay]], the {{PAGENAME}} can shelter Helldivers from weather hazards like [[Acid Storms]], negating their effects upon them.

The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 3rd page of the [[Viper Commandos Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|medals|60}}.

== Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Weapon}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Knives will fly slightly to the left of the crosshair and have a modest arc to their flight path, necessitating a fair amount of skill and practice to land consistent weak spot hits.
* The throwing knife can bypass shields (such as the [[SH-32 Shield Generator Pack]]'s) under certain circumstances.
* Thrown knives cannot currently be retrieved, regardless of where they've landed. The K-2 also cannot be used in melee, even if specifically wielded.
* The Throwing Knives are thrown silently, they will not alert static enemies if you miss or kill nearby enemy with a single throw.
** Killing any unit in patrol with a knife will be noticed by the rest of the enemy group, forcing them to search your last known location.
* It is possible to disable [[Automaton Mine|Automaton Mines]] by throwing knives at them. The knife must not hit the mine directly - as this will cause the mine to detonate - but instead hit the ground right next to the mine. Shooting a disabled mine will still cause it to explode.
* Knives can be used to destroy Ammo Dumps in [[Sabotage Supply Bases]] missions.
* Resupplying from the [[B-1 Supply Pack|Supply Pack]] or the [[Resupply]] stratagem will refill 20 knives.
* Knives can be used to silently dispatch [[Agitator|Agitators]] with a single headshot.

== Trivia ==

* Knives can bypass shields at low speeds, which seems to be a reference to the [[wikipedia:Dune_(novel)|Dune]]<nowiki/>series of books. 

== Known Issues ==

* When hosting a game, Helldivers may often experience a bug where their throwing knives will alert nearby enemies when they are thrown, or when they miss their target. Enemies may also be alerted even if a nearby enemy was taken out in one knife. To alleviate this, the knife wielder should designate another Helldiver as the host.
